units.source_text: 很快，发长彦等人飞到了来时路过的三岔路口的天空当中，

en.t: Before long, Kaminagahiko and the others flew into the sky above the three-way crossroads they had passed on the way there,

units.source_text: 黑狗继续飞行，他却清楚的看到上次遇见的两位武士不知从何处归来，

en.t: as the black dog kept flying, he clearly saw the two warriors he had met last time returning from somewhere,

units.source_text: 两人并肩骑马，正快马加鞭的赶去京城方向。

en.t: The two were riding side by side, urging their horses on as they hurried toward the capital.

units.source_text: 这时，发长彦突然想把自己解救了两位公主的事情告诉他们，

en.t: At that moment, Kaminagahiko suddenly wanted to tell them that he had rescued the two princesses,

units.source_text: 于是命令黑狗道：“飞下去吧，

en.t: so he ordered the black dog, "Fly down,

units.source_text: 飞到那个三岔路口出吧。”
